title: FTC for a Lipschitz function along a line, given a.e. differentiability on the segment
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let u : ℝⁿ → ℝ (ℝⁿ = Euclid n) be L-Lipschitz for some L ≥ 0, let p, v ∈ ℝⁿ and a, b ∈ ℝ. Suppose that for Lebesgue-almost every τ ∈ ℝ with τ ∈ [min(a,b), max(a,b)], u is Fréchet differentiable at p + τv. Then u(p + bv) − u(p + av) = ∫_a^b Du(p + τv)v dτ (oriented interval integral), where Du = fderiv ℝ u.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : Euclid n → ℝ) (L : NNReal) (p v : Euclid n) (a b : ℝ), LipschitzWith L u → (∀ᵐ τ : ℝ, τ ∈ Set.uIcc a b → DifferentiableAt ℝ u (p + τ • v)) → u (p + b • v) - u (p + a • v) = ∫ τ in a..b, fderiv ℝ u (p + τ • v) v
